rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality expanded/full blastocyst with zona thinning, compact ICM, and cohesive TE, appropriately noting limits of a single image and deferring to lab grading. Minor issue: it questions 3 vs 4 expansion without image-confirmed necessity.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, Day 5 timing, endometrial thickness, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong embryo and young age improve prognosis, while 7 mm lining and BMI modestly temper expectations. Probability estimate is well supported.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons. Slight overreach in some generalized outcome estimates and discussion of progesterone monitoring depending on protocol.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support adherence, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and specific future evaluations if unsuccessful.
